maya (docs): FYI pushed a docs PR that adds a micro-guide + runnable SDK snippet for tiered rate limits and metering dashboard sample data. Link in PR: https://git.redwood/rdw/docs/pulls/1423 :eyes:
vincent (eng): saw it, nice. Can you call out the exact header name customers must send for metering? we still get confused between X-Redwood-Meter and X-RW-Metrics in support tickets
samir (pm): also please add a short note about how burst credits interact with tiered quotas (one line) — product wants clarity for enterprise UX
maya (docs): yes — added a short paragraph. For headers I used `X-Redwood-Metering: <meter-id>` in the snippet so it's explicit. Example:```bashcurl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -H "X-Redwood-Metering: project-123" 
 -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate```
jen (dev): quick nit: in the JS SDK sample we should show how to set per-request tier, e.g. `client.request({path:'/generate', headers:{'X-Redwood-Tier':'pro'}})` — otherwise users miss the override option
maya (docs): good call, added JS snippet and a short YAML example for dashboard ingestion mapping.
docs-preview-bot: Preview deployed to https://deploy.previews.redwood/docs/1423 — expires in 48h
vincent (eng): I ran the sample data into staging dashboard, metric names look fine but the label `tier` is coming through as `tier_name` from the ingestion lambda. We should either normalize docs or update the lambda. Which preferred?
samir (pm): prefer docs note for now — changing ingestion in prod infra requires ops window. Add a translation note: "tier_name in ingestion == tier in UI"
maya (docs): added a short footnote and updated the example Grafana panel query to use `tier_name`. Example query snippet I added:```promqlsum(rate(redwood_requests_total{job="ingest"}[$__rate_interval])) by (tier_name)```
jen (dev): lgtm. One more test: can you include a tiny migration checklist for customers upgrading from the old ratecaps endpoint? just 3 bullets
maya (docs): done — bullets: 1) ensure `X-Redwood-Metering` header present, 2) map `tier`->`tier_name` if using old ingestion, 3) verify burst credits show under "Allowance" in dashboard. Kept it terse.
vincent (eng): approved from eng side. I left an inline comment on PR about the prometheus label usage but it can be merged after one doc reviewer approves.
samir (pm): approved. Thanks Maya — product happy with wording.
maya (docs): thanks all — assigning to @jen for final docreview and then I'll merge and request translations. :thumbsup:
